user.title: Add feed
user.description: Enter the URL of an RSS or Atom feed. It is fetched once so its name can be filled in for you.

data_description.url: The address of the RSS or Atom feed to watch.

name.title: Name the feed
name.description: The feed was fetched and parsed. Items found: {item_count}.

data_description.name: Pre-filled with the title the feed reports, or with the host of the URL when it reports none. Edit it to taste; clearing it keeps the suggestion. This becomes the name of the feed everywhere: the entry, the device, the entity and the feed title in every event. You can rename it later in the UI.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the feed URL.
error.invalid_feed: The URL did not return a valid RSS or Atom feed.

data_description.update_interval: How often the feed is polled.
data_description.initial_items: How many of the newest items to announce when the feed is first added. 0 announces nothing. Not limited by the maximum items per poll.
data_description.max_items_per_poll: Maximum number of items announced per regular poll. Remaining items are announced on later polls, but they are not queued: an item that drops out of the feed before a later poll reaches it is never announced. 0 means unlimited. The first poll after adding a feed ignores this and announces the initial items.
